title: Crispy Uni Skewers
description: A delicious Slovakian-inspired dish featuring crispy uni skewers, perfect for a quick lunch or snack. Serve immediately for the best experience.

ingredients.name: Uni
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen uni works well for this recipe

ingredients.name: Slovakian Bread Crumbs
ingredients.notes: You can substitute with regular bread crumbs for a similar effect

ingredients.name: Slovakian Paprika
ingredients.notes: Add a smoky flavor to your skewers

ingredients.name: Garlic Powder
ingredients.notes: Enhance the flavor of your uni

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Garnish with parsley for a pop of color

instructions: 2. In a shallow dish, mix together Slovakian bread crumbs, Slovakian paprika, and garlic powder.
3. Dip each piece of uni into the bread crumb mixture, coating evenly.
4. Place the coated uni pieces onto skewers.
5. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. When the oil is hot, add the skewers and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
7. Transfer the skewers to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for an additional 5-7 minutes.
8. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with salt to taste.
9. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
